title: WHEN JUDGMENT BECOMES NOISE: HOW DESIGN FAILURES IN LLM JUDGE BENCHMARKS SILENTLY UNDERMINE VALIDITY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical and psychometric validity of LLM-judged benchmarks using metrics like schematic adherence and factor analysis. While 'Safety' is included as one of the evaluation criteria, the study is an analysis of benchmarking methodology and reliability rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
